meta.connection: A finish you can apply and release on the tap is power you control. Leaving a break unrepaired is choosing not to release, not to reset. The tap is the invitation to repair. This week asks whether you take it.
meta.takeaway: Naming the break you never fixed is the first step toward repair.

slides.title: Have you ever broken something with someone and left it broken?

body.text: Stick and Pull Foot Sweep Game

items: The overhook player wins by putting the underhook player on a knee or his back.
The underhook player wins by lifting him, getting behind him, or picking up a leg.

body.text: Closed Guard Opening, Hands on Body

items: The top player wins by getting to his feet and opening the guard.
The bottom player wins by stopping the top player's win for 30 seconds. Then you switch roles.

body.text: Head and Arm Strangle, Close Position Start

items: The top player wins with the arm trapped at the head.
The bottom player wins by touching that elbow to his body.
